name: krutagidon-simulation-codex
description: Headless deterministic simulation engine scaffold for Krutagidon 2.

scripts.simulate: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-simulation-menu.js
scripts.simulate:mass: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-mass-simulation.js
scripts.simulate:single: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-single-game.js
scripts.analyze:best-move: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-best-move-analysis.js
scripts.diagnose:analyzer: npm run build -- --pretty false && node scripts/run-analyzer-diagnostics.mjs
scripts.benchmark:simulation: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-benchmark.js --kind simulation
scripts.benchmark:analyzer: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-benchmark.js --kind analyzer
scripts.benchmark:effect-runtime: npm run build -- --pretty false && node scripts/run-effect-runtime-benchmark.mjs
scripts.benchmark:epoch: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-benchmark.js --mode compare
scripts.benchmark:epoch:calibrate: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/run-benchmark.js --mode calibrate
scripts.generate:drafts: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/generate-drafts.js
scripts.report:runtime-coverage: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/report-runtime-coverage.js
scripts.validate:drafts: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/src/cli/validate-drafts.js
scripts.test: npm run clean:dist && npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/tests/run-tests.js
